# Support

For questions about running the PDDL planner, setting up the ROS 2 Humble workspace, or reproducing the paper figures, open a [Question issue](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/turtlebot3-ai-service-robot/issues/new?template=question.yml).

Before opening an issue, check:

- [Root README](../README.md) for dry-run and Gazebo simulation setup
- [Planning README](../planning/README.md) for CLI goal formats and module layout
- [IEEE Paper (PDF)](../docs/AI_Robotics_Planning.pdf) for system design and experimental notes
